methods.name: StockReservationEntry.get_row_reserved_qty
calls: frappe.qb.from_(sre).select(Sum(sre.reserved_qty - sre.transferred_qty - sre.delivered_qty)).where((sre.docstatus == 1) & (sre.name != self.name) & (sre.item_code == self.item_code) & (sre.voucher_type == self.voucher_type) & (sre.voucher_no == self.voucher_no) & (sre.voucher_detail_no == self.voucher_detail_no)).run

methods.name: get_sre_reserved_qty_for_items_and_warehouses
calls: frappe.qb.from_(sre).select(sre.item_code, sre.warehouse, Sum(sre.reserved_qty - sre.delivered_qty - sre.transferred_qty - sre.consumed_qty).as_('reserved_qty')).where((sre.docstatus == 1) & sre.item_code.isin(item_code_list) & (sre.delivered_qty < sre.reserved_qty) & sre.status.notin(['Closed', 'Delivered'])).groupby

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
calls:
'
		select {select_fields}, posting_datetime as "timestamp"
		from `tabStock Ledger Entry`
		where is_cancelled = 0
		{conditions}
		order by posting_datetime {order}, creation {order}
		{limit} {for_update}'.format

dependencies.call: frappe.qb.from_(sre).select(Sum(sre.reserved_qty - sre.transferred_qty - sre.delivered_qty)).where((sre.docstatus == 1) & (sre.name != self.name) & (sre.item_code == self.item_code) & (sre.voucher_type == self.voucher_type) & (sre.voucher_no == self.voucher_no) & (sre.voucher_detail_no == self.voucher_detail_no)).run

frappe.qb.from_(sre).select(sre.item_code, sre.warehouse, Sum(sre.reserved_qty - sre.delivered_qty - sre.transferred_qty - sre.consumed_qty).as_('reserved_qty')).where((sre.docstatus == 1) & sre.item_code.isin(item_code_list) & (sre.delivered_qty < sre.reserved_qty) & sre.status.notin(['Closed', 'Delivered'])).groupby

		select {select_fields}, posting_datetime as "timestamp"
		from `tabStock Ledger Entry`

		{conditions}

		{limit} {for_update}'.format
